name: @harmonious-union/officer-context-compilation-service
description: Compiles one reproducible purpose-specific officer context from exact Leader source, office law, admitted character chronicle, and authority-classified materials, or returns a typed refusal.

scripts.check: node --check src/canonical.mjs && node --check src/schema.mjs && node --check src/compile.mjs && node --check bin/compile-officer-context.mjs

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: one by-value officer context compilation request carrying exact content-addressed sources and an attenuated authority boundary
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: malformed request, source identity mismatch, contradictory identity reuse, missing Leader source, missing office or character epoch, or authority ambiguity
